content.text: Proration math is duplicated in billing-service, the invoice worker, and the admin CLI. Three implementations already disagree on mid-cycle seat changes: the service rounds half-up after tax, the worker rounds before tax, and the CLI skips partial-day credits entirely.

Move calculateSeatProration, applyCreditBalance, and buildProrationLineItems into @nimbus/billing-proration with a pure unit suite covering 0-day, single-day, leap-day, and multi-currency inputs. Call sites import the package and delete their local copies.

description_text:
Proration math is duplicated in billing-service, the invoice worker, and the admin CLI. Three implementations already disagree on mid-cycle seat changes: the service rounds half-up after tax, the worker rounds before tax, and the CLI skips partial-day credits entirely.
Move calculateSeatProration, applyCreditBalance, and buildProrationLineItems into @nimbus/billing-proration with a pure unit suite covering 0-day, single-day, leap-day, and multi-currency inputs. Call sites import the package and delete their local copies.
